notes.TWN: 自算：碩士（國中教師最普遍的學歷）年資 15 年是 550 薪點，月薪額 49,560 元加學術研究加給 35,780 元，乘以 12 個月加年終工作獎金 1.5 個月，年薪 1,152,090 元，用 IMF 的購買力平價（13.655）換算。依教師待遇條例、人事總處俸額表與年終獎金注意事項（114 年）；學術研究加給表是行政院函的附件，引用臺南大學網站轉載的版本並用臺中市人事處的給與簡明表核對。學術研究加給 OECD 會不會算進去不確定，只算本薪是 48,997；考績獎金、導師費不算。115 年 7 月起學術研究加給預定再加 2,000 元

notesEn.TWN: Own calculation: a teacher with a master's degree (the most common qualification) and 15 years of experience is on salary point 550: NT$49,560 a month plus an academic research allowance of NT$35,780, times 12 months plus a 1.5-month year-end bonus, NT$1,152,090 a year, converted at the IMF's PPP rate (13.655). Based on the Teachers' Remuneration Act, the DGPA salary table and the 2025 year-end bonus rules; the research allowance table is an annex to an Executive Yuan letter, cited from a copy on National University of Tainan's website and checked against Taichung City's pay summary. Whether the OECD would count the research allowance is unclear; base pay alone gives 48,997. Performance bonuses and homeroom allowances are not included. The research allowance is due to rise by NT$2,000 from July 2026
